text:
tara: New hire hitting onboarding bug: node SDK mangles array params for embeddings, but REST works. can someone triage?
li: oof. can you paste the minimal repro? usually a serializer issue.
zach: adding details: curl works:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"model":"embed-1","input":["foo","bar"]}'
```
li: node sdk snippet (from sample app):
```js
const out = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'embed-1',
  input: ['foo','bar']
});
console.log(out.data.length) // -> 1
```
tara: captured outgoing body from SDK shows input as a string:
```
{"model":"embed-1","input":"[\"foo\",\"bar\"]"}
```
zach: that's definitely double-stringified. looks like when building payload for the old http library we call JSON.stringify on every field before assembling bodystring.
li: also noticed SDK sends header `ApiKey abcxyz` not `Bearer`. Quickstart docs use REDWOOD_API_KEY and curl uses Bearer. inconsistent.
tara: new hires copy sample app and get auth failures, so this is a real DX blocker.
zach: two separate fixes: 1) stop double-serializing arrays in node client; 2) standardize auth header to Bearer OR update docs to match SDK. prefer changing SDK to Bearer to match other languages.
li: another issue: SDK auto-retries POSTs on 502 without idempotency checks. leads to duplicate completions for some customers. we should treat POSTs as non-idempotent unless idempotency-key present.
tara: workaround for onboarding: use REST curl in quickstart or map inputs to single-item calls in client until fix lands.
ci-bot: triggered tests for branch devex/fix-node-serializer — failing test: embed-array-shape, onboarding-smoke
deploy-bot: Staging deploy paused until embed-array-shape test fixed.
zach: i'll open a PR tonight with serializer fix + unit tests, and add opt-in idempotency header behavior. pinging @li for docs update.
tara: thanks all — i'll update onboarding guide once PR merged and re-run the smoke tests. :rocket:
